title: Acquirer: Brickworks Ltd; Target: Bristile Ltd

body_sections.Summary: The proposed acquisition of Bristile Ltd by Brickworks Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant markets were considered to be the state markets for the manufacture and supply of clay bricks and pavers.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Bristile and Brickworks both supply bricks and pavers, but mainly do so in separate state markets. The Commission concluded that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to lead to a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets for the following reasons: (i)   the absence of any significant overlap between the parties in each of the           state-based markets (ii)  barriers to entry appear to be low (iii) customers appear to be able to exercise a significant degree of             countervailing power. Accordingly, the Commission concldued that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets and decided not to oppose.
